title: Louisville Slugger Omaha Stick Pack Bat Backpack, Navy, New

comparisons.notes: New, navy, MPN WB5717503 in product schema; in stock; plus $24 shipping or local pickup.

writeup: Woot has the new Louisville Slugger Omaha Stick Pack in navy (model WB5717503) for $19.99. It's a youth bat backpack with two bat sleeves, a separate shoe pocket and a fence hook. Play It Again Sports lists the same navy bag at $59.99, so this is about $40 less. Woot showed only one left when we checked, with a limit of 3 per customer.
